# Generally available: Control shared workloads with throughput buckets in Azure Cosmos DB

## What Changed

Today, we’re excited to announce the general availability of throughput buckets in Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL. You can now set workload-level throughput limits within a shared container, so background work has a clear boundary without requiring a separate copy of your data.
